# Carl’s Villa Whiplash, Priya’s Steady Crown
*Casa Amor-igos (demo league) · Week 3*

Week 3 brought dumped-islander drama, a public-vote return and couples choosing to stick or switch. Priya kept her place at the top, while the points made for a lively little reshuffle of fortunes beneath her.

| # | Player | Total | This week | Move |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Priya | 101 | +17 | – |
| 2 | Dev | 68 | +4 | – |
| 3 | Jolie | 64 | +16 | – |
| 4 | Maya | 36 | +16 | – |

## The group chat report
- **Priya:** Rank 1 is still yours: 101 total after a strong 17 this week. The crown stays put, and the villa can take notes.
- **Dev:** You held rank 2 with 68 total, but just 4 this week. Carl’s departure and return made for a full-on points rollercoaster.
- **Jolie:** Rank 3 remains yours, with 64 total after 16 this week. A solid week—no dramatic climb needed to keep your spot.
- **Maya:** You’re still at rank 4, on 36 total after matching Jolie’s 16 this week. A lively points haul, even if the table didn’t budge.

## Moments that moved the league
- Carl’s dumped penalty cost Dev 20 points, making it the week’s biggest sting.  
  <sub>Receipt: “On Day 20, Casa Amor islanders Amora, Carl, Chay, Corey, Ronnie, and Sydney were dumped from the island after failing to couple up.” · Dumped penalty (-20)</sub>
- Carl’s public-vote return brought Dev 10 points back and softened the blow.  
  <sub>Receipt: “On Day 21, Amora and Carl re-entered the villa after the public voted them back in.” · Re-entered the villa (+10)</sub>
- Kayda and Zach staying together added 6 points across Dev and Priya’s teams.  
  <sub>Receipt: “Kayda and Zach, Melanie and Sincere, and Trinity and Bryce all chose to remain in their couples.” · Survived a recoupling together (+3)</sub>
- Melanie and Sincere sticking together added 6 points across Jolie and Maya’s teams.  
  <sub>Receipt: “Kayda and Zach, Melanie and Sincere, and Trinity and Bryce all chose to remain in their couples.” · Survived a recoupling together (+3)</sub>
- Trinity and Bryce stayed coupled, bringing another 6 points across Jolie and Maya’s teams.  
  <sub>Receipt: “Kayda and Zach, Melanie and Sincere, and Trinity and Bryce all chose to remain in their couples.” · Survived a recoupling together (+3)</sub>

_Next week, every point and every pairing stays in play—keep those group-chat receipts ready._
